events.text: Rehearsals for The Lighthouse Keeper are held in the Bayview Church Hall.
Lighting rental for The Lighthouse Keeper comes from Lumen Stage Hire.
Sound equipment for The Lighthouse Keeper is rented from Brightwell Productions.
The stage manager for The Lighthouse Keeper is Felix Grant.
The standard adult ticket price for The Lighthouse Keeper is 22 pounds.
Opening night of The Lighthouse Keeper is set for 14 November 2026.
Costumes for The Lighthouse Keeper are stored in Room 4, next to Studio B at the Maritime Arts Centre.
Show programmes are printed by Quayside Print.
The set for The Lighthouse Keeper is designed by Hollis Varga.
Company policy: every actor must sign in at the stage door at least 45 minutes before the half is called.
The box office opens at 11am and closes 30 minutes before curtain up.
Rehearsals for the spring tour are held in Studio B at the Maritime Arts Centre.
Lighting rental for the Tidewater Players winter show comes from Lumen Stage Hire.
Lead actor Daniel Shaw's weekly fee is 900 pounds.
Rehearsals for The Lighthouse Keeper moved to Studio B at the Maritime Arts Centre.
We stopped renting from Lumen Stage Hire because two of their moving-head fixtures failed during the spring tech rehearsal and they took four days to send replacements.
Lighting rental for The Lighthouse Keeper switched to Brightwell Productions.
The standard adult ticket price for The Lighthouse Keeper went up to 24 pounds.
Felix Grant left for a touring show, so the stage manager is now Priya Raman.
Correction: the stage manager who took over from Felix Grant is Priya Ramesh, not Priya Raman.
On 3 September 2026 a burst pipe flooded Studio B at the Maritime Arts Centre and damaged several rehearsal props.
Rehearsals for The Lighthouse Keeper moved to the Drill Hall on Quay Street.
The Drill Hall was chosen for rehearsals because it was the only space with a sprung floor that was free at short notice after the flood.
Costumes for The Lighthouse Keeper were moved to the basement storage room under the Harbourlight Playhouse.
Daniel Shaw's weekly fee was raised to 1,050 pounds.
Rehearsals for the spring tour moved to the Bayview Church Hall.
Opening night of The Lighthouse Keeper was pushed back to 21 November 2026 because the set build ran late.
The adult ticket price was raised to 28 pounds to cover the higher lighting rental costs from Brightwell Productions.
The standard adult ticket price for The Lighthouse Keeper is now 28 pounds.
Show programmes are now printed by InkWorks.
Rehearsals for The Lighthouse Keeper moved to the Old Sail Loft on the harbour front.
Lighting rental for The Lighthouse Keeper switched to Northern Rig Co.
The box office now opens at 10am and closes 15 minutes before curtain up.
The standard adult ticket price for The Lighthouse Keeper dropped to 26 pounds.
Opening night of The Lighthouse Keeper moved to 20 November 2026 to avoid clashing with the city marathon.
Priya Ramesh is on medical leave, so Tomasz Wilk is now the stage manager.
Rehearsals for The Lighthouse Keeper moved to the rehearsal annex behind the Harbourlight Playhouse.
